## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -5.16% | 1M: +4.57%) while XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +2.99%); VXX (1W: +7.74% | 1M: -8.86%) RECOVERY and HYG (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND provide the second confirmation.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit signals are supportive: HYG (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +0.86%) ABOVE TREND indicate easing credit stress (HYG/LQD ↑ rising). Offsetting this, VXX (1W: +7.74% | 1M: -8.86%) RECOVERY shows near-term volatility pickup to monitor.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
SPY (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND versus TLT (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.56%) ABOVE TREND keeps SPY/TLT BELOW TREND (↓ falling), so stocks vs bonds is pressured. Dollar in CORRECTION (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +1.19%) and a steepening curve (Yield Curve ABOVE TREND) leave conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals/value showing leadership: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +2.99%) and ITA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +4.73%), while XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -5.16% | 1M: +4.57%) — style: Value/Cyclicals favor over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US equities under short-term pressure: SPY (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND. EM mixed: EEM (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +2.55%) CORRECTION while China FXI (1W: -1.58% | 1M: -6.48%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Small caps showing resilience amid rotation: IWM (1W: -0.55% | 1M: +2.77%) CORRECTION and Small vs Large ↑ rising. Crypto/speculative ETFs remain weak: IBIT (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -21.29%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: -5.76% | 1M: -3.52%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation signal visible in Copper/Gold ratio (↑ rising) but base commodities soft: CPER (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -10.77%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains weak: XLE (1W: -2.77% | 1M: -0.78%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -6.38% | 1M: -13.64%) BELOW TREND; nat gas volatility persists with UNG in CORRECTION (1W: -7.92% | 1M: +2.29%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Financials and credit (XLF 1W: +0.84% | 1M: +2.99% ABOVE TREND; HYG 1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.60% ABOVE TREND) support rotation into cyclicals. Major divergence: XLK (1W: -5.16% | 1M: +4.57%) CORRECTION with SOXX (1W: -2.62% | 1M: +13.75%) and CIBR (1W: -5.77% | 1M: +14.20%) in CORRECTION — this is a MAJOR divergence across core tech/semi ETFs.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor Financials and select Industrials: XLF (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND, ITA (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +4.73%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to Growth/Tech into volatility: XLK (1W: -5.16% | 1M: +4.57%) CORRECTION and QQQ (1W: -3.17% | 1M: +1.40%) CORRECTION.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Financials XLF (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND and Industrials ITA (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +4.73%) ABOVE TREND if credit holds. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -5.16% | 1M: +4.57%) CORRECTION and Energy XLE (1W: -2.77% | 1M: -0.78%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper signal via Copper/Gold ratio (↑ rising) if CPER (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -3.71%) starts to stabilize. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -10.77%) BELOW TREND and Silver SLV (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -22.57%) BELOW TREND remain vulnerable.

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX ~20 for complacency vs stress, HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 for credit health, XLK/XLF spread ~2.0 for growth→value pivot, and SPY support near recent lows defined by the 1W move.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive.  
Financials and small caps/industrials showing relative strength (XLF 1W: +0.84% | 1M: +2.99% ABOVE TREND; IWM 1W: -0.55% | 1M: +2.77% CORRECTION; ITA 1W: +1.93% | 1M: +4.73% ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk is Tech divergence — XLK (1W: -5.16% | 1M: +4.57%) CORRECTION alongside corrections in SOXX and CIBR that could widen volatility.
